content.value_statement: Marketing teams often manage fragmented social, advertising, keyword, and audience workflows. This skill provides one planning and analysis workflow for inbox triage, campaign coordination, and performance review.
actual_capabilities: Consolidates social inbox workflows across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Reddit, and Pinterest.
Prioritizes comments, messages, mentions, and feedback by urgency and message type.
Drafts response options using brand voice, context, links, and calls to action.
Builds campaign plans with channel strategy, timing, assets, budgets, and expected reach.
Reviews advertising metrics such as CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS, conversions, and budget alerts.
Provides keyword, audience, and platform best-practice guidance for marketing decisions.
limitations: It does not provide real-time monitoring or authenticated API integrations by itself.
It does not schedule or publish posts without external tools and platform setup.
It does not generate final creative assets or images.
Marketing metrics are examples unless the user supplies live platform data.

use_cases.title: Triage Social Conversations
use_cases.description: Review comments, DMs, mentions, and customer feedback across platforms, then prioritize urgent replies.

use_cases.title: Optimize Paid Campaigns
use_cases.description: Compare CPA, CTR, ROAS, budget pacing, audiences, and keywords to find practical optimization actions.

use_cases.title: Plan Cross-Platform Launches
use_cases.description: Create platform-specific messaging, timing, budget allocation, and analytics plans for coordinated launches.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Social Inbox
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these recent comments and messages from [platforms]. Group them by urgency, message type, and recommended next response.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Platform Mix
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-channel plan for [offer] aimed at [audience]. Include recommended platforms, message angle, cadence, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Campaign Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this campaign data for [timeframe]. Compare platforms by spend, CTR, CPA, ROAS, conversions, and budget pacing. Recommend three changes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Launch Command Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a full launch plan for [product] with [budget], [timeline], [audience], and [channels]. Include messaging, platform roles, budget allocation, tests, and reporting.

output_examples.input: Review five Instagram comments, two LinkedIn questions, and one angry Facebook message.
output: Urgent: Facebook complaint needs a same-day support reply with ownership and a private follow-up path.
High: LinkedIn product questions need concise answers and a demo call invitation.
Medium: Instagram praise can receive short thank-you replies that reinforce the campaign message.

output_examples.input: Analyze a campaign with strong TikTok engagement, weak Pinterest conversions, and high LinkedIn ROAS.
output: Shift Pinterest toward awareness because conversion efficiency is weak.
Increase LinkedIn budget in a controlled test because ROAS is strongest.
Use TikTok creative learnings for upper-funnel content and retarget engaged viewers elsewhere.

output_examples.input: Plan a product launch across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, and email.
output: Use YouTube for education, TikTok for short teasers, Instagram for visual proof, and LinkedIn for business value.
Use Reddit only for transparent discussion and support-focused participation.
Track reach, engagement, click-through rate, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS by channel.

best_practices: Provide platform data, audience details, budget, dates, and goals before asking for recommendations.
Review response drafts before publishing them to customer-facing channels.
Check each recommendation against platform policies, brand rules, and consent requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to publish posts or change ad spend without connected tools and approvals.
Do not treat sample benchmark metrics as live account performance.
Do not reuse one message unchanged across every platform and audience.

faq.question: Does this skill connect directly to social media accounts?
faq.answer: No. It describes workflows and recommendations. Direct account access requires separate integrations and authorization.

faq.question: Can it schedule posts automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill can plan scheduling recommendations, but publishing requires a supported scheduling tool.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Reddit, Pinterest, and major ad platforms.

faq.question: Can it analyze live campaign performance?
faq.answer: It can analyze live performance only when you provide current metrics or connect an external data source.

faq.question: Is it useful for small teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps small teams prioritize channels, draft responses, and focus budget on the strongest opportunities.

faq.question: Does it replace a marketing strategist?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and analysis, while final strategy, approvals, and brand judgment remain with the team.
